title: petrorhagia prolifera subsp. nanteuilii
intro: Petrorhagia prolifera subsp. nanteuilii, commonly known as French pink or pink purslane, is a perennial plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Petrorhagia prolifera subsp. nanteuilii include wound healing, pain relief, and the reduction of inflammation. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
